title: Create anchored color lexicon and proportional type scale for responsive controls
creator: Maya Patel
description: We need a cohesive, engineering-friendly set of design tokens that: (1) anchors colors to semantic usage rather than purely numeric ramps, (2) defines a proportional typography scale that adapts to density and responsive breakpoints, and (3) simplifies spacing/radius and shadow/elevation so component implementations (buttons, tables, charts) have predictable visual hierarchy across themes and densities.
background: Over the past year we've accumulated multiple ad-hoc token ramps across products. Teams report mismatch between chart backgrounds and control surfaces, inconsistent radii across table rows + popovers, and typography that becomes visually heavy at smaller densities. This creates maintainability burden for engineering and leads to visual regressions during rollouts (e.g., runtime-1.18). Accessibility audit flagged insufficient contrast in mid-tone chart axes under the current palette.
proposal: Produce a canonical 'anchored' color lexicon: a set of semantic anchors (background, surface, interactive, critical, support) each with three functional stops (base, emphasis, muted). Adopt a proportional modular typography scale (ratio 1.125) with named roles (ui, label, body-compact, body, headline). Normalize spacing to a 4px strict baseline with a small set of semantic spacing tokens (xs/s/m/l/xl) and introduce variable radii tokens that map to density (pill/rounded/small). Condense elevation into three system layers (low/medium/high) with explicit blur/offset/opacity values for light and dark themes. Deliver token JSON + usage guide + component migration plan.
decisions: Use semantic anchoring for colors instead of exposing raw palette indices to component teams
Typography uses modular scale with base 16px and ratio 1.125. Provide both px and responsive rem tokens
Spacing base is 4px. All layout tokens derive from multiples of base with semantic names: spacing-xs (4), -s (8), -m (16), -l (24), -xl (40)
Radius tokens map to density: radius-small (4px), radius-regular (8px), radius-pill (9999px) and will be applied via component density flags
Elevation simplified to three layers. Use ambient+directional combination for charts to keep axes readable in dark theme
tradeoffs: Semantic anchors reduce direct control for visual exploration—designers must request new anchors if a use-case is outside the set
Proportional scale reduces bespoke font sizes but requires one-time rework of legacy screens
Condensing elevation layers limits fine-grained shadow control; can increase perceived sameness across components but improves predictability and perf

acceptance_criteria: Canonical token JSON (light/dark/high-contrast) is merged into tokens repo
All core components (Button, Table, Chart, Popover) accept the new semantic tokens and render visually equivalent or improved at default density
Automated visual diff baseline shows no high-impact regressions for top 20 routes
Contrast checks pass WCAG AA for text and WCAG AAA for decorative UI where applicable
Migration guide published and at least one product team completes a demo migration using the guide
